description: The landscape of one category on Archestack (archestack.com): what it covers, the leaders with their main strength and weakness, how many projects are permissive, copyleft, run without a GPU or have arm64 builds, the best pick for each need (permissive, no GPU, arm64, live demo, most stars), what is rising in it this week, and thin spots (needs no project meets). Use it when the user wants to understand a field before choosing ("what are my options for vector databases"); for the plain ranking use top_in_category, to pick across several layers use recommend_stack.

category.description: Category id or title, e.g. "vector-db" or "Vector databases"

name: explain_category
title: Map one category
